verdict.rationale: Factory documents assigning a Linear or Jira issue, or mentioning @Factory in an issue comment, so Droid will "investigate, implement, and test the work." That maps directly onto diagnosing and fixing a reported bug. It is backed by delegation with diff review and tiered autonomy for running without manual confirmation. Missing for 10: bug-specific diagnosis docs (e.g. reproducing failures, root-cause analysis), and independent or hands-on corroboration that autonomous fixes succeed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent autonomously diagnose and fix a reported bug

citations.quote: Assign a Linear issue to Factory or mention `@Factory` in an issue comment to have Droid investigate, implement, and test the work.
Assign a Jira issue to Factory or mention `@Factory` in an issue comment to have Droid investigate, implement, and test the work.
Delegate a task, review the diff, and merge from the App or your terminal.
Droid exec uses tiered autonomy to control what operations can run without manual confirmation.
Droid analyzes your codebase, proposes changes, and shows what will be modified before applying anything.
